headlines.title: USS Lincoln to Be Replaced After Record 9 Months in Middle East
headlines.description: There are mounting concerns from lawmakers and military families over conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln which is on a record deployment in the Middle East. While the Pentagon and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth are downplaying concerns, another aircraft carrier is now on its way to the region to replace the Lincoln. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Luigi Mangione Expected to Plead Guilty in UnitedHealthcare Case
headlines.description: Accused killer Luigi Mangione is set to appear in federal court where sources familiar with the matter tell NBC News he’s expected to plead guilty to federal stalking charges. Because of New York’s double jeopardy law, any agreement at the federal level could cloud the future of the state murder and weapon charges he faces. NBC’s Sam Brock reports and senior legal correspondent Laura Jarrett joins TODAY with analysis.

headlines.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to allow White House ballroom construction to continue
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump on Friday asked the Supreme Court to allow him to continue construction of a sprawling ballroom adjacent to the White House.

headlines.title: U.S. Ambassador Huckabee condemns ‘Israeli terrorists’ for siege of West Bank homes
headlines.description: Dozens of Israeli settlers have trapped two Palestinian families in their West Bank homes for days, cutting off food, water and electricity. Their actions even drawing the ire of U.S. Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee. The IDF says settlers were dispersed, but some remain. NBC News' Matt Bradley reports from the occupied West Bank.

headlines.title: Selena Gomez and her mom accused of fraud over their mental health startup
headlines.description: Superstar Selena Gomez and her mother are accused of defrauding investors of their mental health startup, Wondermind, in a federal lawsuit filed Thursday.

headlines.title: Surrogate Gives Birth Amid Legal Dispute With Biological Parents
headlines.description: A baby born on Wednesday is now in the custody of his biological parents. The surrogate had fled to Texas to give birth after the parents asked her to terminate the pregnancy at 20 weeks when the baby was diagnosed with a severe heart defect. Now, the surrogate is fighting to get the baby back. NBC's Ryan Chandler reports for TODAY.
